<!--
================================================================
AP-LS ANNUAL CONFERENCE PAGE TEMPLATE
================================================================
Two kinds of content live on this page:

1. YEARLY FACTS (set once at rollover): year, city, dates, hotel
   name and address. Find and replace each placeholder in the
   copied files ("Replace in Files"):
     20XX, PRIORYEAR, CITY, ST, March D-D 20XX, March D, 20XX,
     HOTEL NAME, HOTEL ADDRESS, https://HOTEL-WEBSITE-URL

2. THROUGH-THE-YEAR FACTS (updated as details arrive): notes,
   deadlines, links, and rates. These come from the conference
   Google Sheet via conferences/_update-conference.R, which writes
   conferences/data/*.csv. The R chunks on this page read those
   CSVs. Co-chairs edit the Sheet; nobody edits the values here.

Stage guide for the Sheet (details in README.md):
  STAGE 2  Call opens: set submissions_note and the cfp_* keys,
           then update cfp/index.qmd
  STAGE 3  Room block opens: set hotel_note + hotel_booking_url.
           The booking callout appears on its own.
  STAGE 4  Schedule released: set schedule_note
  STAGE 5  Registration opens: set registration_note +
           registration_url (a Register button appears on its own)
           and update the registration-rates tab
================================================================
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(aplsr)     # rowwise_table()
library(htmltools) # div(), tags$*, a(), span()
library(purrr)     # pmap()
library(stringr)   # str_c()

# Sheet-driven facts and rates, refreshed from the conference Google
# Sheet by conferences/_update-conference.R. The path is built from this
# document's location so the page keeps reading its own year's data
# after it moves into the archive.
library(readr)
data_dir <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "data")
conf_info <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "info.csv"),
                      col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE)
info <- setNames(as.list(conf_info$value), conf_info$key)
info <- lapply(info, function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else x)
rates <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "registration-rates.csv"),
                  col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r toc}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

content <- rowwise_table(
  ~name, ~icon, ~link,
  "General", "info-circle", "#info",
  "Proposals", "send", "cfp/index.qmd",
  "Registration", "person-add", "#registration",
  "Hotel", "airplane", "#hotel",
  "Schedule", "person-workspace", "#schedule",
  "Workshops", "easel", "preconference/index.qmd",
  "Archives", "journal-text", "archive/index.qmd"
)

div(
  class = "bg-light",
  div(
    class = "bg-breakout",
    div(
      class = "inner-container",
      div(
        class = "boxed-wrapper",
        div(
          class = "boxed-feature-grid",
          pmap(content, \(name, icon, link) {
            div(
              class = "boxed-feature-grid__item",
              div(
                class = "boxed-feature-grid__icon",
                a(
                  href = link,
                  class = "boxed-feature-grid__link",
                  `aria-label` = name,
                  tags$i(class = str_c("bi-", icon, " boxed-feature-grid__i"))
                )
              ),
              div(class = "boxed-feature-grid__title", name)
            )
          })
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
```

:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Room block: when hotel_booking_url is set in the Sheet, the booking
# callout appears; until then the note shows on its own.
if (nzchar(info$hotel_booking_url)) {
  cat(
    '::: {.callout-important}',
    '### AP-LS Room Block!',
    '',
    info$hotel_note,
    '',
    sprintf('[Book Room {{< fa arrow-right aria-hidden="true" >}}](%s){.btn-action .btn .btn-secondary .btn-lg role="button"}',
            info$hotel_booking_url),
    ':::',
    sep = "\n"
  )
} else {
  cat(
    '::: simple-info-center',
    '',
    paste0('[', info$hotel_note, ']{.h5}'),
    '',
    ':::',
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```

## Registration {#registration}

::: {.panel-tabset .box-shadow}

### {{< fa bullhorn >}} Info

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Registration: when registration_url is set in the Sheet, a Register
# button appears under the note.
reg_lines <- c("::: simple-info-center", "",
               paste0("[", info$registration_note, "]{.h5}"), "")
if (nzchar(info$registration_url)) {
  reg_lines <- c(reg_lines,
                 sprintf("[Register {{< fa arrow-right aria-hidden=\"true\" >}}](%s){.btn-action .btn .btn-secondary .btn-lg role=\"button\"}",
                         info$registration_url),
                 "")
}
reg_lines <- c(reg_lines, ":::")
cat(reg_lines, sep = "\n")
```
